records.name: Google ADK (Python)

features_notes.durable_resume: Invocation/node-path replay, persistent sessions and outstanding-call checks; external effects remain outside atomic event persistence.
features_notes.os_sandbox: ContainerCodeExecutor hardens its own execution path; arbitrary FunctionTools remain host-controlled.
features_notes.skills: Skill toolset/package surface exists; not treated as equal to complete coding-agent policy.
features_notes.web_ui: Development/API tooling, separate from the in-process agent core.
features_notes.approvals: FunctionTool confirmation and resumability are configurable.

dims.loop: Event-producing LLM flow with preprocess/model/postprocess stages, resume decisions and Workflow node execution.
dims.providers: BaseLlm adapters; static/dynamic instructions and cache configuration remain separate policies.
dims.tools: Typed FunctionTools, MCP toolsets, code executors and validation/confirmation hooks.
dims.context: Optional event compaction using token/invocation windows; stale compactions discarded.
dims.state: Session services, invocation replay and rewind; rewind cannot undo external side effects.
dims.safety: Tool confirmation plus optional hardened container code executor; host functions require host policy.
dims.extensibility: Global plugins, agent callbacks, request/response processors and service substitution.
dims.multi_agent: LLM delegation, parallel TaskGroup execution and new Workflow graph APIs with migration caveats.
dims.surfaces: Python API, Runner/services, development web/API tooling and headless execution.
dims.observability: OpenTelemetry dependencies, event traces and evaluator infrastructure; no live evaluation performed.

records.one_liner: A broad event-driven agent and workflow framework with concrete resume machinery and pluggable persistence.
key_insights: Runner services and event flows separate agent logic from session, artifact and deployment infrastructure.
Invocation/node-path replay and rewind do not atomically reverse or deduplicate external tool effects.
ContainerCodeExecutor hardening applies to that executor, not arbitrary host FunctionTools.

records.name: Google ADK (TypeScript)

features_notes.durable_resume: Documented implementation supports a static-graph rehydration subset; TS invocation IDs advance per turn. Do not assume Python parity.
features_notes.compaction: Runner configuration/surface reviewed; Python compaction internals do not prove equivalent TS semantics.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Python container hardening must not be attributed to this SDK.
features_notes.mcp_client: Toolset surface present; no interoperability test performed.
features_notes.approvals: Confirmation/resume surface present; no cross-language parity assertion.

dims.loop: Independent TypeScript Runner/agent implementation; graph rehydration explicitly scopes supported structures.
dims.providers: TypeScript BaseLlm contract; provider breadth independently narrower than an assumed Python mirror.
dims.tools: TypeScript tool abstractions and toolset integrations.
dims.context: Session/request context services; compaction parity not established.
dims.state: Static-graph deterministic rehydration with distinct invocation semantics and dynamic/parallel barriers.
dims.safety: Tool permission/confirmation surfaces; Python container guarantees not inherited.
dims.extensibility: Plugins, callbacks and injectable runner services.
dims.multi_agent: Workflow and subagent APIs; current rehydration limitations matter for dynamic graphs.
dims.surfaces: Node/browser package exports and in-process SDK.
dims.observability: Events/services inspected; full telemetry implementation not audited.

records.one_liner: A separate embeddable ADK implementation whose replay coverage must be assessed independently from Python.
key_insights: The TypeScript SDK is an independent implementation with Node and browser exports.
Static-graph rehydration has narrower coverage and different invocation semantics than the reviewed Python runtime.

checks: Python App/Runner/LLM flow and node-path replay inspected
Resume client-call trust boundary and rewind limits inspected
FunctionTool validation/confirmation and container defaults inspected
Python parallel execution and compactor stale-result handling inspected
TypeScript manifest, Runner and explicitly scoped rehydration semantics inspected
verification.limits: Pinned files and cited line ranges reviewed; no provider calls, package installs, runtime tests, security penetration tests or crash-injection experiments were performed.
